profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with interest in Internet technologies. These days I'm an ML generalist working on large-scale multi-modal AI systems. In the past I've worked on infrastructure problems like databases, large-scale distributed systems, design for high availability and scalability, and backend engineering in general.

Languages: Java, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, C/C++
OS: Mac OS X, Linux, Windows

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ML Tech Lead driving embedding models that power content understanding across Meta's family of apps. Shipped multiple production foundation models serving billions of requests a day.

Previously:
* FAIR Seamless: Speech/Machine Translation
* Distributed Training Infra
positions.insights: Skills: PyTorch · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Speech Recognition

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PYdLIvBHe2E

Before Keyspaces, I worked on core distributed systems that underpin many critical services at AWS and Amazon Retail.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on improving the highly available version of Stardog.

Distributed Systems, Graph Databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer on the Stardog team. Shipped the first highly available version of Stardog, as well as other client-facing semantic web applications and frameworks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented highly scalable, web service based applications for integrating and managing worldwide data from one of the company’s major clients. Technologies used: Java, SQL Server, Force.com and Ruby on Rails.

projects.title: Stardog
projects.description: Stardog is a fast, commercial RDF database: SPARQL for queries; OWL for reasoning; pure Java for the Enterprise.
